description: Level-3 MOM OperationsSegment (ISA-95 Part 2 / B2MML OperationsSegment): one step of an OperationsDefinition (routing), with the material and equipment class it needs. No source yet — fed in the sim-v5 wave (routings are write-only in sim-v5 today).

attributes.name: operations_segment_no
attributes.description: Identity of the OperationsSegment (join key). Recommendation: <operations_definition_no>.<sequence>.

attributes.name: operations_type
attributes.description: ISA-95 operations type of the step.

attributes.name: sequence
attributes.description: Position of the step within its OperationsDefinition.

attributes.name: operations_definition_ref
attributes.description: The OperationsDefinition (routing) this step belongs to.

attributes.name: process_segment_ref
attributes.description: The ProcessSegment (reusable stage) this step performs.

attributes.name: equipment_class_ref
attributes.description: The equipment class this step specifies.

relationships.description: The routing this step is part of (ISA-95: OperationsDefinition MADE_UP_OF OperationsSegment).
The reusable stage this step performs.
The material this step specifies (B2MML MaterialSpecification).
The equipment class this step specifies (B2MML EquipmentSpecification).

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 2 OperationsSegment = one step of a routing. Its FOR_PROCESS_SEGMENT, SPECIFIES_EQUIPMENT and SPECIFIES_MATERIAL edges now carry the ProcessSegment/EquipmentClass/Article links the old shortcuts drew directly (owner 25.09.).
isa95.mappingNote: sequence and the parent routing are carried by B2MML through the nesting of OperationsSegment in OperationsDefinition, not as fields.
